data.one_liner: Animated radial and pie charts for Flutter
data.what_it_does: Creates animated pie and radial charts in Flutter using data objects. It supports transitions between chart datasets and customizes elements like hole labels and segment edges.
use_when: You need to display simple pie charts or concentric radial charts
You want charts that animate smoothly when data updates
avoid_when: You need complex charts like line graphs, bar charts, or scatter plots
You require advanced interactive chart features beyond basic animations
strengths: Easy to animate and update chart data via GlobalKey
Supports customizable hole labels and round or flat segment edges
weaknesses: Limited chart types (only pie and radial charts)

alternatives.name: fl_chart
alternatives.why_pick_it: Pick fl_chart for a wider variety of interactive chart types including line, bar, pie, and scatter charts.

alternatives.name: syncfusion_flutter_charts
alternatives.why_pick_it: Pick syncfusion_flutter_charts for an enterprise-grade chart library with extensive features and chart types.

alternatives.name: pie_chart
alternatives.why_pick_it: Pick pie_chart for a dedicated, lightweight package focused primarily on pie charts.
